content: FFmpeg segment extraction via child_process.spawn in Node.js: Use spawn(ffmpegPath, ['-ss', startSec, '-to', endSec, '-i', inputPath, '-c', 'copy', '-avoid_negative_ts', 'make_zero', outputPath]). Place -ss before -i for fast seeking. Wrap in Promise: resolve on exit code 0, reject on non-zero. Collect stderr for diagnostics. Convert ms timestamps to seconds: (ms / 1000).toFixed(3). Use os.tmpdir() for temp directory, cleanup with fs.rm(path, { recursive: true }) in finally block. For stitching: write filelist.txt with 'file PATH' lines, then run FFmpeg concat demuxer command.
